Name: Elasah
Summary: Elasah, son of Shaphan, was one of the two men Zedekiah sent to Babylon with Jeremiah's letter to the exiles.
KeyStory: Elasah son of Shaphan carried Jeremiah's letter to the captives in Babylon alongside Gemariah son of Hilkiah.
LifeLesson: A messenger's name may be all that survives — and that is enough, if the message was delivered.
